lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, appearing narrower on the anterior torso and widening toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the fifth line from the anterior, splitting approximately 40% of the way down from the dorsal ridge. A partial intersection is also visible on the penultimate posterior line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 2, 7, 9, and 12 exhibit discontinuities, terminating as abbreviated segments that do not span the full vertical distance from the dorsal crest to the ventral region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch. The spots are concentrated in a triangular formation on the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-posterior haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line approximately 20 pixels in length.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate spiral trajectory, initiating at an upward vector of approximately 80 degrees relative to the skull base and curving medially at the terminal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is 3.5 times the pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-toned tipping comprises approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest extending from neck to tail; distinct white V-shaped chevron between the eyes; two high-contrast white spots on the cheek; orange-tan coloration on the lower limbs contrasting with the dark torso.
